translated: Welcome to ProSeka AfterTalk: "Our Survival Struggle" edition! Yeah! And we're live!
Um, kon-niigo, everyone! I'm Hinata Sato, the voice of Mizuki Akiyama from N25.
This ProSeka AfterTalk is a program where we look back on the event story
and enjoy the AfterLive together with everyone watching.
This time, we're covering the "Our Survival Struggle" event.
It just ended yesterday, May 9th,
so I hope you all enjoyed the story and the music!
I didn't realize the background would be this white, so wearing white today makes me look like a floating head, like that Gachapin green screen fail.
It looks like I'm filming a self-tape for an overseas audition or something, which is kind of funny, but the content itself...
The N25 story is really getting into some deep territory now, so
I hope you'll all look back on it with me.
When you're posting your thoughts on the event or this stream, please use the hashtag #ProSekaAfterTalk.
The staff have set up the YouTube chat so I can see it right here, and I want to pick out some of your comments.
"You're merging with the white."
I really am, aren't I?
"I love your bangs."
Thank you!
There it is.
"Surprisingly white."
Yeah, it's like a laundry detergent commercial.
Thanks for the comments.
Since Mizuki had straight hair this time, I decided to go with a sleek, straight look too. You can really see my mic now.
You get a great view of the lapel mic and my face.
I'd say it's a perfect composition.
I'll keep picking up comments like this as we go.
